newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks soar to all-time high.
newsitem.headline: French stocks soar to all-time high.

text.p: The CAC-40 blue chip index hit an all-time high of 2,921.70 in late morning trade, up 63.44 points before shading back slightly.
The rise was powered mainly by technical factors linked to the expiry of CAC-40 share options contract on Monday, traders said.
The dollar's robust performance was also supporting the market, they said.
At 0945 GMT, the CAC-40 index was up 62.30 points or 2.18 percent at 2,920.70. The CAC-40 futures contract was up 50 points at 2,923.0 from Monday's close.
